shell_commands:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for usage accumulation across tool rounds

Define acceptance tests for ticket #93: Report usage across every tool round,
not just the last. Tests verify that:
- Multiple tool rounds accumulate usage into a sum
- Single-round turns (no tools) report unchanged usage (backward compatible)
- Rounds with missing usage are handled gracefully (no undefined/NaN)
- The feature scales to 3+ tool rounds

Current state: 3 tests fail (feature not yet implemented), 5 tests pass
(backward compatibility verified).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo "Branch is up to date with origin/main" || echo "Branch diverges from origin/main - merging..."
npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A 5 "● ChatOrchestrator usage accumulation across tool rounds"
